business_summary: Nakamura Choukou Co., Ltd. develops, manufactures, and sells precision equipment, chemical fiber spinning nozzles, and therapeutic science-related products in Japan. The company operates through Special Precision Equipment Business; Chemical Fiber Spinning Nozzle Business; D-Next Business; and Materials Science Business segments. It offers DINA-PRISM, a diamond wire cutting tool for the slicing process of electronic materials used in solar batteries, LEDs, etc.; PHX-01, a diamond wire manufacturing equipment; and high-precision equipment comprising wear-resistant parts for use in the manufacturing of bearings, electronics, and machine tools; adsorption nozzles that are used to pick and place electronic parts, automatic nozzle cleaners for electronic part adsorbing nozzles; and micro reactor items, including automated flow reactors, micromixers, and mass flow controllers for gaseous reagents, as well as automatic nozzle cleaner. The company also designs, manufactures, and sells spinnerets, precision parts, and machinery units for synthetic and chemical fibers, and meltblown and spunlace nonwoven fabrics; manufactures and sells industrial equipment, such as shower plates, fuel injectors, and medical devices, as well as filters; and sells spinneret cleaning equipment and detergents. In addition, it is involved in the design and distribution of diamond-wire production machine and diamond-wire for semiconductor; design, manufacture, and distribution of chemical fiber spinning nozzle and its peripheral parts, nonwove-fabric production machine, and nonwoven-fabric peripheral nozzles; design, manufacture, and distribution of high-precision parts and tools; and development, manufacture, and distribution of nano-size zeolites powder. Nakamura Choukou Co., Ltd. was founded in 1954 and is headquartered in Sakai, Japan.
business_summary_ko: Nakamura Choukou Co., Ltd.는 일본에서 정밀 장비, 화학 섬유 방사 노즐 및 치료 과학 관련 제품을 개발, 제조 및 판매합니다. 회사는 특수 정밀 장비 사업을 통해 운영됩니다. 화섬방사노즐사업 D-넥스트 비즈니스; 및 재료 과학 사업 부문. 태양전지, LED 등에 사용되는 전자재료의 슬라이싱 공정을 위한 다이아몬드 와이어 커팅 공구 DINA-PRISM을 제공합니다. 다이아몬드 와이어 제조장비 PHX-01; 베어링, 전자제품, 공작기계 제조에 사용되는 내마모성 부품으로 구성된 고정밀 장비; 전자부품의 픽 앤 플레이스에 사용되는 흡착노즐, 전자부품 흡착노즐용 자동노즐클리너; 자동 흐름 반응기, 마이크로 믹서, 가스 시약용 질량 흐름 컨트롤러, 자동 노즐 클리너를 포함한 마이크로 반응기 품목. 이 회사는 또한 합성 및 화학 섬유, 멜트블로운 및 스펀레이스 부직포용 방사 구금, 정밀 부품, 기계 장치를 설계, 제조 및 판매합니다. 샤워플레이트, 연료분사기 등 산업용 장비를 제조, 판매하고 있습니다.
